# Does my MT940 statement balance, and why won't it import?

> Free MT940 checker: finds why a SWIFT MT940 bank statement fails to import or does not balance (opening plus transactions versus closing, gaps between statements, bad :61: lines, period decimals, repeats), with line numbers, and converts it to CSV. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
